node.text:
Pedri’s spin 🔄
#LaLigaHighilights

El FC Barcelona i la Reial Societat han arribat a un acord per al traspàs d’Héctor Fort. El FC Barcelona  es reserva una opció de recompra i es guarda un percentatge d’una futura venda.

FC Barcelona and Real Sociedad have reached an agreement for the transfer of Héctor Fort. FC Barcelona retain a buy-back option and a percentage of any future sale.

El FC Barcelona y la Real Sociedad han llegado a un acuerdo para el traspaso de Héctor Fort. El FC Barcelona se reserva una opción de recompra y un porcentaje de una futura venta.

@sonambajwa @nushrrattbharuccha and @chunkypanday spotted in Delhi along with @ajaychoudharay - CMD of ACE Group, at the launch of @acegroupofficial ’s 25th landmark project, ACE Arte.

The Bollywood stars came together to celebrate the coming together of art and architecture, as ACE Arte was unveiled as the group’s latest landmark project, set to come up in Sector 150, Noida.

From the star-studded guest list to the grand unveiling, the evening was all about celebrating a new chapter for ACE Group and the vision behind ACE Arte. ✨

#ace #bollywood #bestofnoida #luxuryliving #realestate

node.text:
Typical things our gang does 💀

[Ola S1 Z, OlaElectric, EVIndia, EV under 100,000, EV under 1 Lac, Best EV in India, EV with latest Technology]

#sarcasm #reels #viral

India has achieved many firsts that changed the way we live, travel, and grow. 🇮🇳⭐️

From the first Aadhaar holder to the first solar airport, water metro, and rapid rail, these milestones showcase the country’s journey towards innovation and progress. 🔥

#sarcasm #india #viral #bharat #asia

Two completely different footballers. Two completely different paths. One rivalry that defined an era. 🐐

Messi and Ronaldo were almost opposites in everything. Messi became the left-footed genius built around close control, creativity and playmaking. 

Ronaldo became the explosive right-footed goalscoring machine built around power, movement and relentless finishing.

- Adidas vs Nike.
- Barcelona vs Real Madrid.
- No.10 vs No.7.
- Argentina vs Portugal.
- América vs Euros.

Different physiques. Different personalities. Different styles.
Yet somehow, they pushed each other to heights football had never seen before.🤯🔥

For more than a decade, every goal, trophy and record seemed to lead back to the same question: Messi or Ronaldo?🙇🏻‍♂️👑

Maybe that debate will never truly be settled — and that’s exactly what made their rivalry so special. Two legends. Two completely different versions of greatness. ❤️

#sarcasm #messi #ronaldo #goat #rivalry

The box office journey of these franchises shows just how dramatically their theatrical reach has evolved. From KGF: Chapter 1’s ₹250 crore worldwide run to KGF: Chapter 2 crossing ₹1,200 crore, and from Don’s ₹106 crore to Don 2’s ₹209.55 crore, the growth is striking. Awarapan’s ₹12.5 crore run has now been followed by Awarapan 2’s ₹220.49 crore worldwide collection. 

[MissMalini, Box Office Evolution, KGF, Don Franchise, Awarapan Franchise, KGF Chapter 2, Don 2, Awarapan 2, Bollywood Box Office]

#MissMalini #BoxOffice #KGF #Don #Awarapan

Rome wasn’t built in a day😴

Back in 2018, Akon unveiled plans for a $6 billion ‘real life Wakanda’ in Senegal. Akon City promised futuristic skyscrapers, renewable energy, and a crypto powered economy. 

Years later, the ambitious vision stalled, with Senegal canceling the project in 2025 and reclaiming most of the land.

[via/ Bloomberg]

#sarcasm #senegal #akon #viral #wakanda

A heartwarming Rakhi moment we won’t forget ❤️

#GIVA #SilverRakhi #RakshaBandhan #Rakhi #Wholesomeinternet

The HEART and SOUL of Spider-Man!❤️

Before cinematic universes dominated pop culture, Rosemary Harris delivered one of the most perfect, iconic performances in superhero history as Aunt May in Sam Raimi’s original Spider-Man trilogy (2002-2007).

She didn’t just play Peter Parker’s aunt; she gave the entire franchise its moral compass. Her gentleness, quiet strength, and unwavering love grounded Tobey Maguire’s Peter Parker through every hardship.

Her legendary “I believe there’s a hero in all of us” monologues in Spider-Man 2 remain the absolute peak of superhero wisdom. An acclaimed Tony and Emmy Award winner (and Oscar nominee), she brought immense prestige and warmth to comic book cinema.

No matter how many reboots come and go, Rosemary Harris will always be the gold standard for Aunt May.

#sarcasm #spiderman #legend #hollywood #auntmay
